Title: Ch 1 — The Exile
Goal of Scene: Establish Maren's disgrace and the impossible task
Summary: Maren is publicly stripped of her guild rank and given an ultimatum: chart the Salt Road or be exiled forever.

Title: Ch 2 — The Offer
Goal of Scene: Force the protagonist onto the road
Summary: A mysterious patron funds the voyage but attaches a dangerous condition.

Title: Ch 3 — Last Night Ashore
Summary: Maren says goodbye to her estranged sister; old wounds resurface.

Title: Ch 4 — The Poisoned Sea
Goal of Scene: First taste of the antagonist (the sea itself)
Summary: The crew crosses into the salt fog; the first sailor falls ill.

Title: Ch 5 — Mutiny Whisper
Summary: Tension boils over as supplies run short.

Title: Opening — The Whistle
Summary: The 3pm shift whistle blows for the last time; layoffs announced.
